note: Videos the front page and the app feed never show, and whose thumbnails are never copied to this site. The site's rights line is no club crests, kits, sponsor marks or match photographs anywhere, and a YouTube thumbnail that is a frame of match footage, or shows a replica shirt, would put one on the home page. Add an id here to keep a video off; remove it to let it back. scripts/fetch-videos.mjs and loadVideos() in scripts/videos/lib.mjs both read this file.
